title: ModelDiff
description: The `data` payload of `dmtool model diff <baseFile> <headFile>` (MODEL-REVIEW-SPEC §5) — a STRUCTURAL diff of two models: it parses both into the model and compares structure, so a pure reformat is never reported. `changes` lists every field and rule that was added, removed, modified, or reordered between base and head, each with the per-aspect `deltas` that changed (a rule's condition/severity/code; a field's kind and per-kind config; a reorder carries a `position` before→after delta). For an ADDED element a delta carries only `after`; for REMOVED, only `before`; for MODIFIED/REORDERED, both. Element ids are field paths or rule full names.

changes.description: the element-level changes (fields and rules added/removed/modified/reordered) — base order, then head-only additions

element.description: the element family that changed (computation/group are a later slice)

id.description: the element's path (field) or full name (rule)

change.description: how the element changed between base and head (REORDERED = same element, different position within its parent)

risk.description: the change's risk tier (the max over its reasons; loosening > tightening, since a loosened/removed rule silently accepts bad data)

riskReasons.description: the risk reason codes — a subset of the SPEC §5b taxonomy. HIGH (silently accepts bad data): RULE_REMOVED, POLARITY_INVERTED (a rule's condition was flipped to its logical complement — it now accepts what it used to reject; detected structurally from the two ASTs), KIND_CHANGED, SEVERITY_DOWNGRADED, CONSTRAINT_LOOSENED. MEDIUM (fails loudly / undetermined direction): RULE_ADDED, CONSTRAINT_TIGHTENED, STRUCTURE_ADDED/REMOVED, PATTERN_CHANGED, SEVERITY_CHANGED, SCALE_CHANGED, and — for a non-inverted condition change, classified from the ASTs — CONDITION_RESTRUCTURED (a clause was added/removed), REFERENCE_CHANGED (it reads different fields), OPERATOR_CHANGED (an operator swapped within the same shape), THRESHOLD_CHANGED (only a literal/threshold operand moved); CONDITION_CHANGED is the fallback when the condition can't be parsed for analysis. LOW: CODE_CHANGED, METADATA_CHANGED, POSITION_CHANGED (a pure reorder — the element moved within its parent; display-order is semantic but not a validation loosening).

deltas.description: the aspects that differ — every aspect for ADDED/REMOVED, only the differing ones for MODIFIED; a REORDERED element carries a single `position` delta (before/after = its 1-based index among its common siblings)

aspect.description: the aspect name (rule: condition/severity/code; field: kind/scale/min/max/minLength/maxLength/pattern; a reorder: position)

before.description: the base-side value (absent when the element is ADDED)

after.description: the head-side value (absent when the element is REMOVED)
